purpose: Give JANUS source-integrity-gated read-only JSON field DIVE and deterministic HRAiN structural/iNaiHR associative navigation across its existing public GitHub catalog. Eliminate race between changing main manifest and shards and reduce total traversal time.

implementation_revisions.result: CLI --read-source --pointer & browser on-demand verify/dive into actual JSON fields. Exact Git blob SHA1 and Meta Registry SHA256 verification; capped at 2MB; source untrusted data.

Resolve latest catalog manifest commit via exact GitHub history endpoint, then read both manifest and every shard using that single immutable source commit; refuse mutable main fallback. This repairs observed production SHA mismatch under concurrent automatic refresh.
Concurrent 8-worker bounded reading of immutable shards, SHA verification of all segments, deterministic index order, fail closed on any bad shard.

CLI.method: Authorized user's Yaksa Windows terminal; checked against publicly published GitHub catalog, actual source file and remote verified blob bytes

HRAiN_BROWSER.method: Actual headless Chrome launch through user's authorized Yaksa PC

read_race.observed_before_fix: Real HRAiN CLI remote index failed closed with SHARD_SHA256_MISMATCH on assets/janus-json-atlas/shards/0018.json when raw mutable main manifest and shard were inconsistent.
read_race.after_fix: All published manifest and shard reads pinned to immutable GitHub catalog commit SHA; successful real 88-shard traversal and verified original JSON pointer.

measured_full_index_walltime.benchmark_caveat: Single before/after wall-clock measurements over live public endpoints; not a controlled replicated throughput benchmark.

next_improvement: Use exact-source JSON pointer evidence links to build explicit source-grounded relations in the JANUS 5D knowledge graph. Do not promote associative/semantic similarity as truth; use TOPA before scientific claims.
